about: The Weekday tool on nibrascode.com displays the name of the weekday for a given date. It runs entirely in the browser, does not send any data to a server, and shows the result directly on the page after the user enters a date in YYYY‑MM‑DD format.

This function is useful when you need to quickly verify which day of the week a date falls on, for scheduling, historical research, or simple planning. The tool only outputs the day name; it does not modify calendars and allows the result to be copied or downloaded as a file.
steps: Open nibrascode.com and navigate to the Weekday page.
Enter the desired date in the format YYYY‑MM‑DD.

Copy the result or use the download option to save it as a file.
uses: Check the weekday of upcoming meetings.
Verify class days in an academic schedule.
Identify the day of historical events.
Generate date‑weekday pairs for programming scripts.
faq: What date format does the tool accept?
The tool only accepts dates in ISO format (year‑month‑day, e.g., 2026‑10‑11). Other formats are not recognized.
In which language is the result shown?
The weekday name is displayed in the language selected for the page, such as English, Azerbaijani, Russian, Arabic, or Turkish.
Is any data sent to a server?
No, all calculations are performed locally in the browser, and no input data leaves the user's device.
